entities.name: The Parting
entities.description: Cataclysm on Cridhe that killed the Clan Tree and split the land and its people.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: Plane on which the Parting occurred.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Exiled sangrazul banished to Cridhe for treachery against Tempe, who manipulated Nohr.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: Ambitious mage who performed the ritual on the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Clan Tree
entities.description: The singular source of green mana on Cridhe.

entities.name: Raphos
entities.description: Blacksmith killed by Nohr while trying to stop the ritual.

entities.name: The Maker
entities.description: Creator-god of Cridhe who laid an ancient curse.

entities.name: Nohrland
entities.description: Region whose jungles withered into mushroom forests.

events.summary: Malvos manipulated Nohr into performing a ritual upon the Clan Tree.
events.quote: manipulated Nohr into performing a ritual upon the Clan Tree of Cridhe

events.summary: Raphos tried to stop the ritual and was killed by Nohr wielding Malvos's sword.
events.quote: The blacksmith Raphos attempted to stop the ritual and was killed by Nohr

events.summary: The ritual killed the Clan Tree, fulfilling the Maker's curse and splitting the land in two.
events.quote: the land split in two, physically and spiritually dividing the people of the plane

events.summary: Nohr's descendants were afflicted with madness and the Long Winter followed.
events.quote: Those descended from Nohr were afflicted with madness

relations.quote: The blacksmith Raphos attempted to stop the ritual and was killed by Nohr
having been banished to Cridhe for his treachery against the planeswalker Tempe
